artifact_retention: retain successful and failed manifests; no silent deletion
cpu_gpu_determinism: record device, driver, flags; deterministic CPU defaults
local_virtual_environment: create only with explicit Gate2 approval
mixed_precision: disabled unless explicitly authorized and deterministic
package_version_lock: record exact versions in environment lock before Gate2
secrets: never write secret or env values to artifacts
temp_cleanup: clean only task-owned temp files after hashes are recorded
